SELECT typeof(s.milliseconds) AS storage_type, count(*) AS winner_rows, count(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count, min(s.milliseconds) AS min_ms, max(s.milliseconds) AS max_ms, count(s.time) AS text_times, min(s.time) AS sample_time, sum(s.positionOrder <> 1) AS order_differences
FROM races AS r JOIN results AS s ON s.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975 AND s.position = 1
GROUP BY typeof(s.milliseconds)

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    r.year,
    ((SUM(w.milliseconds) + 5 * COUNT(*)) / (10 * COUNT(*))) / 100.0 AS mean_winner_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS w ON w.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND w.position = 1
  AND w.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year
LIMIT 1000
